featured_reviews.name: Mei Har Yap
featured_reviews.review_text:
The rating has nothing to do with the quality of ayurveda treatments offered as I didn't finished the whole session mainly because I was very put off by :
1) The condition of the treatment & shower room
2) Masseuse/practitioners are unable to converse in any other language. Front desk personnel only explained that it involved oil.
3) Hygiene is doubtful - a big no no for me.

The pictures speaks for itself. I was asked to lie on the uncovered wooden traditional table. Paint & wood shows significant wear and tear -  (you can feel scrapes of paint/wood coming off) - so I can feel with my hand that it is very prickly. And no - they are not offering to put anything on top to make it any more comfortable - besides telling you to relax.

Chanting music was played - perhaps it is part of the shirodara treatment - but it is impossible to relax with that music (my personal opinion).

Lying down on that wooden table - is the last straw. I asked to shower - as I was already drenched in oil from head/hair massage. Oil smells like some sort of nut/coco oil mix (not pleasant at all - and no one explains what's in it).

The shower room - considering the thickness and viscosity of the oil used  - all they provide is a bottle of handwash. The towel is the smallest and thinnest I have seen - it's almost like a muslin washcloth.

I left halfway through the session as I cannot bring myself to complete it - it is highly uncomfortable and I am not happy with the condition of the place.  Front desk was apologetic - I offered to paid the full price as they did not offer any resolution and I am dying to leave and get myself cleaned up properly. The shirodara experience was charged at approximately 3,900 INR for 75 mins. I can get a nice massage for around the same price - without the trauma  - for 90 mins in a decent place.

This can be a mix of expectation gap in treatment (I have minimal idea what shirodara will involved - i.e lots of oil involved) and poor hygiene/condition of the treatment room.
